description:
[0.98a] Courier Service v0.0.3

Order ships, weapons, and hullmods, sourced from real markets in the Sector and delivered to one place.

This is a lightweight QoL mod that adds a new character, John Courier, to the comm directory on Eochu Bres. John Courier lets you doordash (almost) everything you need to build your fleet. Pick what you want, place an order, and your items will be sourced from markets across the sector and delivered to your personal storage. No more flying from system to system hoping the right weapon is in stock, provided you're willing to pay the steep markup.

Features

(Almost) Full Vanilla catalogue of all ships, weapons, and hullmods in the game, organized by category. Variants other than Pirate and Luddic Path are not included.Sourced from real markets. The courier pulls items from Open and Black Markets. If an item isn't in stock anywhere, your order stays open until it is.

Orders can't be canceled or refunded once placed. If you order a paragon and it never arrives, that's on you. Ships are delivered as-is, d-mods and all.

All pricing values are configurable in CourierService/data/config/courier_service_settings.json.
